---
title: "Lecture-Objective and Review-Theme Coverage"
---

This page documents the coverage rule used to construct the weekly banks. The lecture presentations are the scope authority; end-of-lecture Chapter Review assignments are treated as high-priority themes and are paraphrased rather than reproduced verbatim.

## Week 5 — Lectures 13–14

- General sensory pathways, receptor classes, transduction, adequate stimulus, receptor potentials → MCQ 1–10; SR 1–3
- Receptive fields, lateral inhibition, intensity/duration coding, adaptation → MCQ 5, 9–11, 25–27; SR 2–3, 12
- Somatic senses, proprioception, pain/referred pain → MCQ 2, 12–13; SR 4–5
- Olfaction and Golf/cAMP signalling → MCQ 15–16; SR 6
- Taste qualities and transduction strategies → MCQ 14, 17; SR 7
- Hearing, cochlear transduction, pitch/loudness, auditory pathway → MCQ 18–24; SR 8–10
- Assigned Chapter 10 higher-level comparison/drawing themes → SR 11–12

## Week 6 — Lectures 15–17

- Eye anatomy, refraction, accommodation, visual problems → MCQ 1–4; SR 1
- Retina, rods/cones, receptive fields, phototransduction, visual pathway → MCQ 5–9, 27; SR 2–4
- Somatic motor organization and NMJ → MCQ 10–11, 28; SR 5
- Muscle hierarchy and sarcomere proteins → MCQ 12–14, 25–26; SR 6
- Ca²⁺ regulation, cross-bridge cycle, sliding filament, E-C coupling, relaxation → MCQ 15–19; SR 7–9, 12
- Twitch, summation/tetanus, motor units/recruitment, length–tension → MCQ 20–24; SR 10–11

## Week 7 — Lectures 18–20

- Cardiac myocytes, pacemaker cells, intercalated discs, E-C coupling → MCQ 1–4; SR 1–2
- Heart anatomy, valves, unidirectional flow → MCQ 5–6; SR 3
- Ventricular and pacemaker action potentials, refractory period → MCQ 7–10; SR 4–5
- Conduction system and AV delay → MCQ 11–12; SR 6
- ECG components and interpretation → MCQ 13–16; SR 7
- Wiggers diagram, valve events, heart sounds, pressure-volume logic → MCQ 17–19, 26–27; SR 8–9
- SV, CO, Frank–Starling, chronotropy, inotropy, sympathetic control → MCQ 20–25, 28; SR 10–12

## Week 8 — Lectures 21–23

- Vessel types, flow/pressure/resistance, velocity → MCQ 1–4; SR 1–3
- Capillary exchange and lymphatics → MCQ 5–6; SR 4
- Arterial pressure reservoir, MAP calculation/determinants, blood volume → MCQ 7–10; SR 5, 8
- Myogenic, metabolic, and sympathetic arteriolar control → MCQ 11–13; SR 6
- Baroreceptors and baroreceptor reflex → MCQ 14–17; SR 7–8
- Blood composition, plasma proteins, hematopoiesis, EPO, RBCs, anemia → MCQ 18–23; SR 9–10
- Hemostasis/coagulation and ABO/Rh → MCQ 24–27; SR 11–12
- Midterm constraint that Lectures 22–23 are MCQ-only → MCQ 28; applied to all three practice exams
